description: Enable the layout-cache feature to work in no_std environments, specifically targeting embedded systems where CPU usage is critical. This will dramatically improve rendering performance from ~10fps to 300-500fps for the same applications. The implementation should maintain compatibility with existing std builds while adding minimal overhead.
functional_requirements: Make layout-cache functionality available in no_std builds without requiring std dependencies
Add critical-section as a dependency for layout-cache that works in both std and no_std environments
Ensure the layout cache implementation doesn't leave any trace or overhead in standard builds when not enabled
Maintain backward compatibility with existing layout cache usage patterns and APIs
